removed.name: urllib3.contrib.appengine.AppEngineManager
removed.note: Removed support for Google App Engine Standard Environment

removed.name: urllib3.PoolManager.connection_from_pool_key
removed.note: Removed default value of None for the request_context parameter

removed.name: urllib3.util.ssl_.DEFAULT_CIPHERS
removed.note: Removed DEFAULT_CIPHERS from the private module urllib3.util.ssl_

removed.name: urllib3.util.ssl_.HAS_SNI
removed.note: Removed HAS_SNI from the private module urllib3.util.ssl_

removed.name: urllib3.util.ssl_.USE_DEFAULT_SSLCONTEXT_CIPHERS
removed.note: Removed USE_DEFAULT_SSLCONTEXT_CIPHERS from the private module urllib3.util.ssl_

renamed.note: Changed name of Retry.BACK0FF_MAX to be Retry.DEFAULT_BACKOFF_MAX.

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.match_hostname
behaviour_changed.note: Removed fallback on certificate commonName in match_hostname() function. Instead only subjectAltName is used to verify the hostname by default.

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.response.HTTPResponse.read
behaviour_changed.note: Only returns an empty bytes object to indicate EOF, never returns more bytes than requested, and can issue any number of system calls.

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.HTTPConnection.getresponse
behaviour_changed.note: Returns an instance of urllib3.HTTPResponse instead of http.client.HTTPResponse

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.util.ssl_.create_urllib3_context
behaviour_changed.note: Changed to not override the system cipher suites with a default value. The new default will be cipher suites configured by the operating system.

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.response.HTTPResponse.read
behaviour_changed.note: Changed to raise an error when calling with decode_content=False after using decode_content=True to prevent data loss

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.HTTPConnection
behaviour_changed.note: All parameters in the HTTPConnection and HTTPSConnection constructors are now keyword-only except host and port

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.HTTPConnection.getresponse()
behaviour_changed.note: Changed to set the socket timeout from HTTPConnection.timeout value before reading data from the socket.

behaviour_changed.name: urllib3.PoolManager
behaviour_changed.note: Changed the _proxy_host property to _tunnel_host in HTTPConnectionPool to more closely match how the property is used (value in HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()).
